chunks: These were the people of 'Ad who denied the signs of their Lord and rebelled against His apostles, and followed the bidding of every perverse tyrant.

key_terms.عَادٌ: The people of 'Ad, an ancient Arab tribe

ai.seo_question: What were the main reasons for the destruction of the people of 'Ad according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the triad of spiritual decay: intellectual denial of divine signs, practical disobedience to prophetic authority, and political submission to tyrannical rulers (jabbarin). The term 'jabbar' is often linked to the concept of divine compulsion or earthly despotism, illustrating how the people of 'Ad succumbed to both internal arrogance and external oppressive structures. This serves as a paradigm for the faithful to remain steadfast against both internal doubt and external tyranny.
